say:1:1610368001:1.text: To the students of the Serene Lyceum, I am honored to visit your distinguished school, celebrated throughout Esperia, to oversee the appointment of the new court mage.
say:1:1610368001:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的学生们，我很高兴能来到这座闻名伊索米亚的魔法...

say:2:1610368002:1.text: I look upon all of you and see wisdom and the fire of determination. These are qualities I personally admire, and ones no court mage should be without.
say:2:1610368002:1.source_cn: 我从你们的眼中看到了智慧与决心——这是我很喜欢的两项品...

say:3:1610368003:1.text: Let the finest among you prove their worth. Bring your wisdom, your unwavering resolve, and your ambition. I await our reunion within the halls of Savannah's palace.
say:3:1610368003:1.source_cn: 我希望你们其中最杰出的人，带着智慧、决心和野心，在赛凡...

say:4:1610368004:1.text: The curtain is soon to rise upon this stage. Yet let it be known, the tides of tomorrow are not swayed by who stands in the court's spotlight.
say:4:1610368004:1.source_cn: 这是一场即将揭幕的演出。但无论谁成为其中主演，你们都要...

say:5:1610368005:1.text: Your potential is boundless. You may walk the path of legends, as Merlin himself once did, and inscribe your name for all eternity upon the sacred annals of Esperia.
say:5:1610368005:1.source_cn: 你们可以成为一切，甚至成为像梅林那样的传奇，将自己的名...
say:5:1610368005:1.male: Your potential is boundless. You may walk the path of legends, as Merlin himself once did, and inscribe your name for all eternity upon the sacred annals of Esperia.
say:5:1610368005:1.female: Your potential is boundless. You may walk the path of legends, as Merlin herself once did, and inscribe your name for all eternity upon the sacred annals of Esperia.

say:6:1610368006:1.text: Let this be the legacy all here strive for.
say:6:1610368006:1.source_cn: 这就是我对你们的期望。

say:7:1610368007:1.text: I now declare the official commencement of the court mage selection!
say:7:1610368007:1.source_cn: 我宣布，宫廷魔法师选拔正式开始！

say:8:1610368008:1.text: Applause and a roar of approval erupt from the gathered crowd. Only when the final cheer has died on the air does the queen turn, her gaze falling intently upon Cyran beside her.
say:8:1610368008:1.source_cn: 人群中传来一阵掌声和欢呼声，等众人渐渐安静下来，王后将...
say:8:1610368008:1.male: Applause and a roar of approval erupt from the gathered crowd. Only when the final cheer has died on the air does the queen turn, her gaze falling intently upon Cyran beside her.
say:8:1610368008:1.female: Applause and a roar of approval erupt from the gathered crowd. Only when the final cheer has died on the air does the queen turn, her gaze falling intently upon Cyran beside her.

say:10:1610368009:1.text: I suppose I should introduce myself. I am the Chief Court Mage of Savannah, Cyran.
say:10:1610368009:1.source_cn: 我想我还是自我介绍一下吧。我是赛凡纳首席宫廷魔法师，迪...

say:11:1610368010:1.text: I will now explain the rules of the selection. I'll only say this once, so I suggest everyone quiet down and listen carefully. It'd be a true pity to be disqualified for breaking the rules.
say:11:1610368010:1.source_cn: 由我介绍选拔的规则。我只会说一遍，所以建议大家安静下来...

say:12:1610368011:1.text: Ahead of you lie <style="highlight">four different tests</style>, with one held each day. Remember, your journey continues only if you successfully clear each hurdle placed before you.
say:12:1610368011:1.source_cn: 选拔赛一共有<style=highlight>四道试题...

say:13:1610368012:1.text: There is <style="highlight">only one</style> successful candidate for the final test... meaning, whoever can pass the final test will be able to become a court mage.
say:13:1610368012:1.source_cn: 最后一场考试的通过名额<style=highlight...

say:14:1610368013:1.source_cn: 规则十分简单易懂，对吧？

say:17:1610368014:1.text: Thank you, Magister Cyran, for your explanation. First of all, I'd like to congratulate you all for successfully reaching the Interrealm. You've now entered the formal selection. Next, I'll announce the subject of the first exam.
say:17:1610368014:1.source_cn: 咳咳……！首先，恭喜各位成功来到“界域之间”，进入正式...

say:18:1610368015:1.text: A court mage must possess sufficiently powerful magic, be skilled in utilizing all manner of spells, and be capable of dealing with every kind of foe.
say:18:1610368015:1.source_cn: 宫廷魔法师必须掌握足够强大的魔法力量，能够熟练运用各种...

say:19:1610368016:1.text: The first test will be on your <style="highlight">magical prowess</style>!
say:19:1610368016:1.source_cn: 所以，第一道题目要测试你们的<style=highli...

say:20:1610368017:1.text: There are three portals here that lead to <style="highlight">the Simulacrum Isles</style>. Your task is to venture onto three islands alone and defeat the powerful foes residing there.
say:20:1610368017:1.source_cn: 这里有三道已被激活的小型传送门，分别通往<style=...

say:21:1610368018:1.text: We will record the total time it takes for the participants to pass through the three islands and <style="highlight">rank</style> them based on the <style="highlight">total time</style>.
say:21:1610368018:1.source_cn: 我们会记录参赛者通过三处岛屿所耗费的<style=hi...

say:22:1610368019:1.text: All participants ranked within the <style="highlight">top 50%</style> will pass the first test.
say:22:1610368019:1.source_cn: 排名位于所有通过者<style=highlight>前...

say:23:1610368020:1.text: You may now ready yourselves for the first part of the exam.
say:23:1610368020:1.source_cn: 那么，大家可以准备第一场考试了。我衷心祝愿在场的各位，...

narration:25:1610368021:1.text: Her Majesty the Queen, Princess Peggy, Headmaster Leymar, and Chief Court Mage Cyran each offer a gracious nod to the gathered crowd.

narration:26:1610368022:1.text: In a flash of activated magic, they are gone, whisked away through the massive portal.
